notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Necronomicon: The Dawning of Darkness, 50% off!
notes.content:
Necronomicon: The Dawning of Darkness is Now Available on Steam and is 50% off!*

In this thrilling point-and-click adventure based on the works of H.P Lovecraft, you’ll traverse the haunting world of Gothic New England, solving puzzles and acquiring information to help Stanton solve the mystery of the Necronomicon.

Also, check out the Meridian 4 Adventure Bundle Vol. 2, which includes Necronomicon!

*Offer ends July 18 at 10AM Pacific Time
